Messages.Author: Deadt...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Card Text: "Sabbat: While Aristotle is ready, every Methusalah has +1
hand size. +1 stealth."

Now the question is, due to the way that card is written - does every
Methusalah gain +1 stealth in addition to the +1 hand size OR is it
just Aristotle that has +1 stealth (on every action).

Im pretty sure its the +1 hand size only, and stealth bonus for Aris.
but ya never know...

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


The latter. Methuselah's can't have stealth.

(And, of course, a period seperates the two, which signifies the end of
the object "every Methuselah". Were it a comma, it would apply to every
Methuselah.)

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: Deadt...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Thanks for the clarification - I ask because I play with people who
will argue a grammatical structure if they think it can give them some
advantage.

Case in point - a player quit (permanently) last night because after
his vampire committed diablery he immediately sent another vampire to
remove the flamethrower from that vampire - as the rest of us were
discussing the process for calling a blood hunt (its an automatic
referendum of course) BUT because we did not call it immediately and he
had "moved on to his next action" he claimed he got to keep the
flamethrower - even if his diablarist got burned.

(It only seems like I play VTES with 2 year olds).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Well, sure he can keep it -- just not on any minion, since the
diablerist was burned and there's no mechanism for moving it
to another minion. :-)

(Note: it really does go to the ash heap -- There are no "slap
jack" strategies in VTES).


